name: wook-post
description: wPost — a local desktop HTTP client for Windows

scripts.build: npm run licenses:sync && npm run typecheck && electron-vite build
scripts.format: prettier --write src tests scripts *.json *.ts *.yml README.md CHANGELOG.md THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md docs rules
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src tests scripts *.json *.ts *.yml README.md CHANGELOG.md THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md docs rules
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run format:check && npm test
scripts.release:win: npm run dist:win && npm run release:publish
